ZAF.note: The reply says nothing of records passing between the civil register and the ID system.

facts.fact: In a written reply of 5 August 2024 the Minister of Home Affairs says the department has a rollout strategy to automate birth registration by connecting health facilities to Home Affairs systems, under an MOU with the Department of Health, staggered over five years to 2024/25.
facts.system: Home Affairs birth registration at health facilities

systems.system: Home Affairs birth registration at health facilities

ZAF.note: The reply mentions a birth certificate on the spot but no identity number given at birth.
The reply states a plan to connect health facilities but no office, count or pilot where births are entered digitally.
